name: [NOW] Hunty Zombie
desc:
🧟 Hunty Zombie is an action-packed zombie hunting game on Roblox! Hunt or be hunted — the apocalypse won't wait. Master weapons, abilities, perks, and awakening

💥 NEW: Party Crasher Mode
🪏 NEW: Sandbox Mode 
🎧 Boombox weapon - Lay down some beat and defeat the Zombies with Style 
⏳ Scythe Returns + Evolution - another Limited Chance to unlock the OG scythe
👁️ Daggers Returns + Evolution - Fast movement and multiplication

🗡️ Hack‑and‑Slash Action
💥 Unique Weapon Abilities
🔮 Awakenings
🎯 Perks & Loadouts
🧟 Zombie‑Packed Dungeon

🎮 Controls
Ability 1 — Z / L2 / LT
Ability 2 — X / L1 / LB
Ability 3 — C / R1 / RB
Dash — Q / B / Circle
Perk — E / Y / Triangle
Awakening — G / D‑Pad Down
Switch Left — 1 / D‑Pad Left
Switch Right — 2 / D‑Pad Right
M1 — LMB / X / Square

⚠️ ALPHA — Game still in development. Bugs expected.
If codes don’t work, try a private server.
